description: Test suite for Job Card functionality in ERPNext manufacturing module, including tests for overlapping time logs, material transfers, and work station changes.

classes.name: TestJobCard
classes.description: Test case class for Job Card operations in manufacturing, including setup, teardown, and various test scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates BOM and work order, sets up test conditions.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Rolls back database changes after each test.

methods.name: test_job_card
methods.description: Tests for operation mismatch error when editing job card.

methods.name: test_job_card_with_different_work_station
methods.description: Tests work station change and time log submission for a job card.

methods.name: test_job_card_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping time logs and raises OverlapError.

methods.name: test_job_card_multiple_materials_transfer
methods.description: Tests transferring multiple raw materials separately against a job card.

methods.name: test_job_card_excess_material_transfer
methods.description: Tests transferring more material than required and handling excess.

methods.name: test_job_card_partial_material_transfer
methods.description: Tests partial transfer of materials and subsequent transfer of remaining quantities.

methods.name: test_job_card_material_transfer_correctness
methods.description: Verifies correct items are pulled in stock entries and impact of 'For Qty' changes.
